name: decomposing union change
from: A high-level design with no low-level design or bounded work-lot plan under it -- too large a grain for any one purchase or mutation to execute against.
to: A LowLevelDesignK and a WorkLotPlanK -- a DAG of bounded, provider-constrained, test-bearing work lots small enough to purchase and execute one at a time.
cost: Provider purchase cost at the lowest observed fractional cost among compatible offers, plus the offices attention keeping the lot plan bounded rather than reopening the whole design.
otherwise: The high-level design is actuated as one undifferentiated mutation, with no bounded lot a provider can price, execute, or be held to.
